pcs.pc_description: Check for pre-alert or advanced shipment notice and mandatory documents before unloading.
Match incoming shipment to a valid Purchase Order and validate PO number, Item codes, Quantity, Supplier details, etc.
Search and confirm the PO in the ERP system once the preliminary QC check is completed.
Prepare an inbound report on received and damaged goods and get it signed by the shipper
Verify GRN (goods receive note) data and put-away accuracy w.r.t to location and inventory.
Trigger the Quality Check workflow if items require inspection, and update ERP with the results, such as Accepted quantity, rejected quantity, Remarks, etc.
Update the inspection lot or status in ERP and assign storage locations (bins/racks) for putaway.
Update bin location, shelf numbers, or zones in ERP and post a transfer posting or putaway confirmation.
Check for approved Sales Order (SO) or Delivery Order and confirm the Correct customer, Required ship date and Order quantity.
Punch orders for manual operations and generate/allocate a pick list for picking.
Use the Outbound Delivery or Pick Ticket function in ERP to Assign Items to pick, Bin/zone locations, picking sequence, etc.
Confirm in ERP once picking is completed, and record any short-picks, damages, or substitutions.
Update the Packing and Weight Entry once the preliminary QC is completed.
Check the delivery manifest with the pick list to verify that the correct products are being shipped out
Check if the delivery data is updated in the system for proper tracking

Check for availability and correctness of appropriate documentation, including air waybill, bill of lading, fumigation certificate, PGA (Participative Government Agencies) documentation, customs documentation, etc.
Prepare the complete outbound report and update it in ERP along with Post Goods Issue (GI) to reduce inventory.

modules.module_title: Print labels, product tags, and other codes

pcs.pc_description: Obtain information from the supervisor and the MIS regarding the ongoing activities for which bar codes, labels, and invoices need to be printed
Check and verify the list in ERP for correctness
Print the bar codes, product tags, address tags, labels, etc. and hand over to the respective supervisors
Maintain a count and record for daily printing activities

pcs.pc_description: Validate the accuracy and completeness of inbound, outbound, and inventory transactions recorded in the ERP/WMS.
Verify key fields such as item codes, quantities, batch/lot numbers, expiry dates, bin locations, and material status for correctness.
Identify incorrect, incomplete, duplicate, or mismatched entries in the ERP/WMS and coordinate corrections with warehouse associates or supervisors.
Escalate unresolved discrepancies, system errors, or master-data issues to supervisors or relevant departments following organisational protocols.
Review entries made into the ERP with respect to daily warehouse operations and monitor correct flow of information across integrated systems.
Ensure closure of pending or incomplete ERP/WMS transactions by coordinating with associates, supervisors, and cross-functional teams.

modules.module_title: Extract Data and Generate Operational Reports

pcs.pc_description: Confirm the Key Metrics and KPIs for analysis with management and extract data from the ERP/WMS according to these KPIs.
Generate various operational data such as rejection reports, delay reports, and operational complaint data.
Generate standard warehouse reports including inbound, outbound, put-away, ageing, and inventory reports.
Provide daily, weekly, and periodic reports to management and stakeholders in line with SLA and KPI requirements.

modules.module_title: Analyse Data and Provide Insights for Improvement

pcs.pc_description: Analyse transactional and operational data flowing through the ERP/WMS with respect to warehouse performance.
Perform analyses such as flow balancing, variance analysis, billing analysis, vendor performance, quality trends, customer fulfilment status, and transporter performance.
Interpret results, identify trends, and generate insights for optimisation and continuous improvement.

pcs.pc_description: Use a checklist based on SOPs and audit guidelines for conducting checks
Identify the sample for quality check from the inbound and outbound shipments, and for bulk goods, inspect a sample (AQL – Acceptable Quality Level).

Conduct a basic product description match, brand match, logo match, manufacturing location match, check for authenticity of the product and check for damages on the packaging with respect to the information in Enterprise resource planning (ERP)
Log any mismatch, damage, or deviation in ERP or QC log and assign a corrective action (e.g., recheck, return to vendor, hold stock).
Prepare a quality check report and update the manager in case of any aberrations with respect to the desired quality and product configuration
Schedule Cycle Counting in ERP, such as daily/weekly/monthly, based on ABC classification.
Obtain a list of stored items along with location and physical quantity from the supervisor and match the same with system data with respect to the location of each item and quantity.
Count items in storage bins, pallets, and shelves manually or with scanners and verify quantity, SKU/barcode, batch/lot, expiration dates, etc.
Assess the number of items to be counted daily, considering the throughput velocity of SKUs and the number of locations touched for picking
In case of discrepancy found in system data versus system data, physically count the number of items and cross-check them with the system report.
Verify inventory records with the system and physical inspection, and record them.
Post Adjustments in ERP for verified discrepancies.
Prepare a reconciliation summary report (discrepancy%, value impact) and escalate recurring issues for process correction.

pcs.pc_description: Pull the delivery list from the Sales Order module or the Transport Queue from ERP.
Use Shipment Creation (SAP VT01N or equivalent) in ERP to group deliveries and combine orders with the same route or customer cluster, with Compatible loading requirements.
Choose vehicle code from ERP transport master (linked to capacity specs) and Select Appropriate Vehicle Type.
Create a Shipment Document in ERP by entering Consolidated delivery numbers, Vehicle type & number, Loading time slot, Route code, Driver info (if available), etc., and assign Delivery Items to it.
Identify transporters based on the shipping requirements of clients
Plan vehicle requirements in terms of the size of vehicles and the number of vehicles based on load movement, and analyse the cost per lane
Finalise the transporter(s) based on lanes, prepare the necessary documentation, and seek requisite approvals
Coordinate with transporters for pickup and Confirm Vehicle arrival time, Driver contact info, Required documentation (e.g., E-way bill, gate pass), etc.
Inform the supervisors in various departments regarding the pickup timing and the transporter schedule
Update the transport information in ERP once pickup is done, and Post Goods Issue (PGI) to reduce inventory and trigger the invoice process.
Verify uploaded PoD and other mandatory fields in ERP once the vehicle reaches the destination and the material in handed over to the consignee

modules.module_title: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders

pcs.pc_description: Coordinate with customers to understand their requirements for receiving, dispatching, tracking orders, goods in transit, SLAs, etc.
Coordinate with departments to resolve queries and provide information
Liaise with clients, suppliers and transport companies and provide the necessary information
Prepare periodic reports and update the management
Obtain the list of claims, the individual claim forms, the claims processing checklist and the inspection checklist from the manager/supervisor
Check the reason in the claim form and perform a visual inspection of the quarantined goods along with the concerned supervisor
Check whether the claims were filed within the authorised timelines and classify claims as outdated or timely
Verify that all the documents required (assessment valuation, invoice/bill, claims and insurance forms, etc.) in the claims processing checklist are present and genuine
Escalate false or outdated claims to the manager
Process the claim documentation to the supervisor/manager for approval, and on receipt of internal approval, forward it to the concerned insurance companies along with evidence and recommendation.
Check the reason in the claim concerned insurance companies along with evidence and recommendation.

pcs.pc_description: Set up the parameters for trend analysis to be done, such as Inventory Levels, Inbound and Outbound Shipments (volume over time), Peak Periods (seasonal trends), etc
Collect the relevant information from ERP/documentation/ standalone computer files for the set parameters.
Apply data filters to process data before conducting analysis.
Create line charts to track monthly or weekly data over time (e.g., outbound shipments per week).
Conduct trend analysis to identify time trends and seasonal trends of operational and business performance
Conduct trend analysis of new business to identify seasonality and cyclical natures
Draw inferences and develop a report based on trend analysis
Identify key parameters for forecasting based on past trends, as well as the regulatory and business environment
Prepare data for the accepted forecasting approach and project future values by averaging past data.
Develop forecasts and consider lead times and supplier reliability when forecasting stock needs.
share the data with management and conduct review meetings to finalize on the forecast
Develop resources, space plans, and budgets based on forecasts in consultation with the manager.
